verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents its own programmatic API: server-side `auth.api` methods, typed client methods such as `authClient.signUp.email`, JWT/JWKS endpoints, and admin operations, so an agent can drive it in code. But no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at any probed path, and a community user reports there is virtually no documentation for building a non-JS client against the underlying HTTP API. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/HTTP API reference, language-agnostic endpoint documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the auth.api methods.
const { data, error } = await authClient.signUp.email({ email, password, name, image, callbackURL: "/dashboard" }
The JWT plugin provides endpoints to retrieve a JWT token and a JWKS endpoint to verify the token.
It allows administrators to perform various operations such as creating users, managing user roles, banning/unbanning users, impersonating users, and more.
